text:
tara: Hey — can someone drop the east-region model health + traces shortlinks? Getting 403 when I try to open the model-health dashboard.
observability-bot: Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/xyz/model-health-east
observability-bot: Traces (Jaeger): https://jaeger.redwood.internal/trace?service=runtime-east
omar: I get 403 on grafana link, same for the jaeger one. probably RBAC. @sam can you check eng-infra perms?
sam: I'm on it. looks like east dashboards are gated to the eng-observability group. Omar, are you in that group?
omar: not sure — I joined eng-sre last quarter, not eng-observability.
sam: I just added you to eng-observability. try now.
omar: still 403. maybe SSO token needs refresh.
omar: ah — re-auth worked, can see dashboards now. thanks.
tara: awesome. while we're here — alert tuning question: model-inference p99 latency for east spiked yesterday, alerts fired a bunch. what's our desired threshold? currently 800ms.
lee: For east we usually keep p95 at 350ms, p99 at 800ms is fine for now but we could tune to 1s during heavy batch jobs. If this keeps happening, consider bumping autoscaler min replicas or enabling KV cache for that model.
omar: can we get the query used for p99? want to sanity-check.
lee: query (grafana/metrics):
```
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(inference_latency_bucket{region="east",model=~"prod-.*"}[5m])) by (le))
```
sam: Also check traces for long tail ops: filter by span name `decode_tokens` and look at `cpu_wait` tag.
tara: ok will run through traces and share a small list of offending traces. thanks all :thumbsup:
omar: FYI I've muted the noisy alert rule for 30m while we investigate (rule: inference_p99_east). will unmute once we confirm root cause.
tara: perfect — keep us posted.
